name: What are common signs that my bay window needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my bay window needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating your bay window may need repair include drafts, condensation between glass panes, visible rot or mold on the frame, difficulty opening or closing the windows, and water stains on interior walls or sills. Cracks in the glass, chipped paint, or weakened structural supports also signal issues. Addressing these early can prevent more extensive damage and maintain energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drafts, condensation, rot, difficulty operating, water stains, or visible damage to the glass or frame.
